exclude.description: Exact, case-sensitive tool IDs to leave unchanged.

tools.description: Explicit inline descriptions for effective tool IDs, including custom/MCP IDs. Highest priority.

toolsDir.description: Directory of {id}.txt overrides. Relative to the plugin Location; supports ~/ and ~\.

configDir.description: V2 customization directory; defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/slim-system-v2 or ~/.config/opencode/slim-system-v2.

systemPrompt.description: Opt in to replacing exactly verified OpenCode 2.2.5 stock system prompts. Unknown/modified prompts and custom agents remain unchanged.
